end.summary: Practised comparing regions and cultures using same/different points in a Venn diagram.
end.parentNote: Riya practised finding similarities and differences in language, festivals, and foods. They gave shared points such as people gathering and foods made on a tawa, and corrected the idea that everyone speaks Hindi at home. Festival details and some food differences remained uncertain; at home, compare two festivals with a simple two-circle Venn diagram and check one fact for each side.
